run_banned_function_check: run the script to check src/core .cc files for banned gRPC function usage
review_BANNED_EXCEPT: review the BANNED_EXCEPT dictionary mapping banned gRPC function signatures to their whitelisted source files
run_sanity_check: run the sanity check script that walks src/core and asserts no banned function violations exist
review_walk_logic: review the os.walk loop that scans .cc files excluding src/core/tsi for banned function calls
run_assertion_check: run the script and verify it asserts zero errors and scans more than 300 files
